walkthroughs.body_html:
Religious & Ethical Teachings about Relationships — a core area of GCSE Religious Studies.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Religious & Ethical Teachings about Relationships brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Religious & Ethical Teachings about Relationships.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.
